title: Japanese Blackberry Teriyaki Skillet
description: A sweet and savory Japanese-inspired dish made with fresh blackberries and a hint of teriyaki sauce, cooked to perfection in a skillet.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced aromatic and cook until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped snappy and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Pour in the teriyaki sauce and stir to coat the snappy.
Add the fresh blackberries and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until they start to break down.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional blackberries if desired.
